Platforms:

Description

I'd KILL YOU as a worm is a difficult platformer where you've been turned into a worm and have to navigate the world in order to find and take out your boyfriend.

Features

  • an open world that you have to climb
  • a worm with a lot of love who needs to climb it
  • around 2 hours of climbing content (if you're good enough)
  • a lot of easy jumps that you will fail.
